ns2:course.label: Social Issues Theatre
ns2:course.description: Research, writing, and production of original plays addressing selected health and social issues on the UIUC campus in cooperation with the Counseling and Health Center. Course emphasizes training in acting and in methods of peer education and discussion facilitation. Same as GWS 418. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Maximum of 6 undergraduate hours or 8 graduate hours. Repeat and graduate students will be required to develop additional projects.
